content: Sosua Kadarala Lipoahrok kei nan Kahnimw Seriko

Sosua ahpw kadarala lipoahrok riemen sang arail kahnimpwal nan Akasia pwe ira en kohla dawih ni rir wehin Kenan oh kahnimw en Seriko. Ira eri kohla nan kahnimwo oh keiruhdi rehn lihen netiki paliwere men me adaneki Reap.
Nanmwarkien Seriko ahpw karongehda me dene mehn Israel kei kodohngehr nan kahnimwo nipwong, pwe re en lipoahroke mwomwen wehio.
Ih eri ketin poaronlahng Reap, mahsanih, “Ohl akan me mihmi nan imwomwen, ira kodohn lipoahroke wehiet! Kahreirahdo!”

Liho eri sapeng, nda, “Mie ohl ekei me patohdo ni imwei, ahpw I sohte patohwan wasa ira patohsang ie. Ahpw ira pwurala nin soutik mwohn ahnsou me wehnimwen kehlo pahn ritidi. I pil sohte patohwan wasa ira kohkolahng ie; ahpw ma kumwail pahn mwadang idawehnirahla, kumwail pahn kak koanoirahdi.” (A Reap kahrelangehr lipoahrok ko pohn pwelengen imweo, oh karukihirahla pahn dihpw kei me e pwilikihdi wasao.)
Eri, sapwellimen nanmwarki sounkair ako ahpw pedoisang nan kahnimwo, oh wehnimwen kehlo ahpw ritidi. Irail ahpw kohla oh raparapahkiseli lipoahrok ko lao lel ahl me kotehla Pillap Sordan.
Mwohn lipoahrok ko ara pahn kommoaldi, Reap ahpw kohdalahng pohn imweo
oh ndaiong ira, “I ese me KAUN-O ketikihongkumwailehr sahpw wet. Aramas koaros nan wehiet re uhdahn masak kumwail.

Se pil rong duwen en KAUN-O eh ketin kammadahda Sehd Weitahta mwohmwail ni ahnsou me kumwail pedoisang nan Isip. Se pil rong duwen amwail kemehla nanmwarkien Amor riemen, me mwareneki Sihon oh Ok, ni palimesehn Sordan.
Se ahpw masepwehkada ni at rongada mepwukat. Eri, kiht koaruhsie pil lamalam tikitikla pwehki kumwail. Amwail Koht iei KAUN-O, ih me Koht en nanleng oh sampah.
Eri, kumwa kahula ni mware me kumwa pahn kadekohng ei peneinei duwehte ei kadekohng kumwa, oh kumwa pil kihong ie mehkot kilel en ei pahn kak likih kumwa.
Kumwa inoukihong ie me kumwa pahn doarehla ei pahpa oh nohno, oh riei kan, oh pil arail peneinei koaros. Dehr mweidohng se en kamakamala!’

Ohl ako ahpw ndaiong liho, “Koht en ketin kemeikitala ma se sohte pahn kapwaiada at lokaia pwukat. Ma ke sohte pahn kasalehiong mehmen dahme se wia, eri se pahn inoukihong uhk me se pahn kadekohng kumwail ni ahnsou me KAUN-O pahn ketikihong kiht sahpwet.”
Reap kin koukousoan nan ihmw ehu me mi pohn kelen kahnimwo. Liho eri ale sahl pwoat oh kadaredi ohl ako sang ni wenihmwtoko.

Ih eri padahkihong ira, “Kumwa alu kohwei nanpwungen uluhl akan, pwe sapwellimen nanmwarki aramas akan de diarkumwahda. Kumwa rukurungki rahn siluh, re lao pwurodo. A mwuri, kumwa ahpw pahn kak kohkohwei.”
Ohl oko ahpw ndaiong liho, “Se pahn kolokol at inou me ke men se en wiahiong uhk.

Eri, iet me ke pahn wia ni ahnsou me se pahn pedolong pwe se en kauwehla sahpw wet, ke pahn pirehiong sahl weitahta pwoat ni wenihmwtok me ke kadarkitedi sang ieo. Oh ke pahn kapokonepene omw pahpa, nohno, riomw kan, oh peneineien omw pahpa koaros, nan imwomwet.
Ma mehmen pahn pedoisang nan ihmwet oh kolahng nan ahl oh mehla, pein ih pahn pwukoahki. Ahpw ma mie me mihmi nan ihmwet ahpw ohla, eri, iei kiht me pahn pwukoahki.
A ma ke kasalehda dahme se wia, eri se sohte pahn kolokol at inou me ke men se en wiahiong uhk.”
Liho ahpw pwungki oh kadarirahla. Mwurin ara kohkohla, liho ahpw pirehiong sahl weitahta ni wenihmwtoko.

Lipoahrok ko eri kohla nanpwungen uluhl kan oh rukurukseli wasao lao lel ahnsou me sapwellimen nanmwarki sounkair ko kaimwsekala arail raparapahkin ira; met erein rahn siluh. Irail sohte diarada mehmen, re ahpw pwuralahng Seriko.
Lipoahrok riemeno ahpw pwuredi sang nanpwungen uluhl akan oh kotehla pillapo. Ira ahpw pwuralahng rehn Sosua oh kasalehiong soahng koaros me wiawiher wasao.
Ira ahpw ndaiong Sosua, “Se uhdahn kamehlele me KAUN-O ketikihong kitail wehio pwon, pwe aramas koaros wasao kin masamasak kitail.”
